patterns.name: lonely-interface
patterns.definition: An interface with one implementation and no test seam.

patterns.name: single-case-dispatch
patterns.definition: A `switch` or lookup table that has one real case, or a registry with one entry, added for variants that do not exist.

patterns.name: trivial-wrapper
patterns.definition: A function that only forwards to another with the same arguments and adds nothing.

patterns.name: growing-dispatch
patterns.definition: Another branch added to a function that is already long and branchy, instead of extracting the new case.

patterns.name: narration-comment
patterns.definition: A comment that restates the next line instead of giving the reason for it.

patterns.name: echo-doc-comment
patterns.definition: A doc comment that repeats the identifier's name and adds nothing.

patterns.name: stringly-state
patterns.definition: State or a closed set of options held in bare strings that are compared in several places.

patterns.name: bool-for-error
patterns.definition: A function that returns `bool` where the caller needs to know why it failed, or that signals failure with a magic value.
